description: This file defines the main React component for the 'Simple Notes Manager' frontend application. It manages notes, handles CRUD operations via API calls, and oversees the UI rendering including sidebar navigation and editor interactions.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component managing notes state, user interactions, and rendering of the app interface.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new note, including optimistic UI update and API call to create the note on the backend.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving/updating a note, with optimistic update and API call.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting a note, with optimistic UI removal and API call.
